description: When posting Obsidian draft content to #content Slack channel, recomposed the message from scratch instead of posting the file content verbatim. Stripped markdown links (Deep Learning Program link, related post link) in the process.
correction: Post the file content as-is. Do not recompose or paraphrase. Markdown links should be converted to Slack link format (<url|text>) but all content must be preserved.
systemic_fix: When posting digest content to Slack: read the file, convert markdown links to Slack format (<url|text>), post verbatim. No recomposition.
